advisory_plan.summary: Priority is (1) to obtain a replication package for the version of record, and (2) to resolve the internal sample-size / missing-data inconsistencies. Severity is dominated by missing materials (ADV-001/ADV-002), not by demonstrated numerical errors.

remediation.action: Publish a complete replication package (TR and PRIO100 builds + Stata .do / R code) for the JCR version of record on Harvard Dataverse or OSF. Verify package integrity (run end-to-end, record sessionInfo/version).
Audit the version of record (final JCR PDF + published online appendix), not the 2012 working-paper preprint. Diff preprint vs published tables and re-certify to the DOI title.
Confirm the exact rows used in Table 6 M1 versus Table 4; explain the +11 cases or align the Ns.
Recompute footnote-12 missing-case percentages against correct per-technology totals; label the scale (TR total deaths vs PRIO100) of min/max/mean.
State the unit of analysis (war vs conflict-year) for the Weibull duration models and reconcile N (1206/899) with the 147/142 war counts.
